simple.meaning: אֱלִישׁוּעַ (ʼĔlîyshûwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Elishua , the son of King David.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֱלִישׁוּעַ (H474) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 5:15, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֱלִישׁוּעַ (H474) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֱלִישׁוּעַ (H474) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H474. Elishua אֱלִישׁוּעַ proper name, masculine ( God is salvation , compare אֱלִישָׁע below; or is opulence , compare אֲבִישׁוּעַ ) son of David 2Sam 5:15 ; 1Chr 14:5 .
